name: Proto-Koreanic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Koreanic is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Koreanic family (Korean and Jeju). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Lee, K.-M. & Ramsey, S. R.
sources.title: A History of the Korean Language
sources.notes: Reference for Koreanic history (structural node only).

location.notes: Glottolog's computed centroid for the Koreanic family — a summary of a whole clade's range, not a place anyone speaks.
